metadata.title: SDK-Backed Transaction Planner Tasks
metadata.description: Implement SDK-backed Random-Improve coin selection, unfrack.it UTxO defragmentation, local min-ADA and fee calculation, and 16KB transaction size guardrails
metadata.importantNote: Never require private keys during planning; enforce <= maxTxSize (16KB) prior to node dispatch; maintain < 500ms selection for 1,000 UTxOs.

phases.name: Runtime SDK Dependency & Planner Models
phases.description: Promote cardano-client-lib to runtime classpath and add planner domain/request/response models

tasks.title: Promote cardano-client-lib to implementation and add planner models
tasks.description: Move cardano-client-lib to implementation in build.gradle.kts and create SelectionMode, TransactionPlan, and backward-compatible request/response fields
tasks.notes: Promoted cardano-client-lib:0.7.3 to implementation and added SelectionMode, TransactionPlan, Conway default ProtocolParameters, and selectionMode/plan metrics fields.

phases.name: Core TransactionPlannerService
phases.description: Implement SDK coin selection (Random-Improve + Largest-First fallback), Defragment mode, MinAdaCalculator, and local CBOR fee/size calculation

tasks.title: Implement TransactionPlannerService
tasks.description: Build local UTxO selection, multi-asset min-ADA calculation, iterative CBOR fee estimation, unfrack.it defragmentation, and 16KB size validation
tasks.notes: Implemented Random-Improve default coin selection, Largest-First + net-unlocked-lovelace fallback, unfrack.it policy-aware defragmentation with binary-searched 16KB prefix packing, MinAdaCalculator, and FeeCalculationServiceImpl.

phases.name: Backend Controller Refactoring
phases.description: Replace greedy sweeps and remote dry-run CLI fee commands in WalletController and NodeController

tasks.title: Refactor WalletController to use TransactionPlannerService
tasks.description: Update calculateTxFee, submitTransaction, and updateStakingAddress to use SDK planning and 16KB validation without CLI dry-runs
tasks.notes: Eliminated remote calculate-min-fee, calculate-min-required-utxo, and dummy build-raw calls; enforced 16KB signed envelope check before submit.

tasks.title: Refactor NodeController to use TransactionPlannerService
tasks.description: Update createNode, updatePoolConfig, updateMetadata, editRelays, retirePool, and submitGovernanceVote to use Random-Improve coin selection and 16KB validation
tasks.notes: Refactored all 6 SPO and governance transaction endpoints via buildAdminTransactionCommand and validateSignedEnvelopeSize.

phases.name: Vue Defragmentation UI & Verification
phases.description: Expose Defragment UTxOs workflow in Vue UI and add comprehensive backend/frontend tests

tasks.title: Add Defragment UTxOs UI in Wallet.vue and SendAdaModal.vue
tasks.description: Add per-wallet Defragment UTxOs action, selection mode toggle, consolidation metrics preview, and store/type bindings
tasks.notes: Added UTxO count badge and Defragment UTxOs action in Wallet.vue, Coin Selection radio group and live planned input/output + 16KB byte budget banner in SendAdaModal.vue.

tasks.title: Add unit, integration, and 1,000-UTxO performance tests
tasks.description: Verify Random-Improve, fallback, Defragment consolidation, 16KB limit enforcement, zero dry-run CLI queries, < 500ms performance, and Vue Vitest specs
tasks.notes: All 42 backend JUnit tests, 80 frontend Vitest tests, 1,000-UTxO < 500ms benchmark, bootJar packaging, and headless Chrome UI screenshots verified.

riskAreas: Preserving tokenLocked and tokenKeepFee semantics expected by SendAdaModal.vue
Handling synthetic non-bech32 addresses and empty protocol-parameters mocks in legacy unit tests
summary.testingNotes: Run JUnit backend suite (including < 500ms 1,000-UTxO benchmark), Vitest frontend suite, and ./gradlew bootJar.
summary.rollbackPlan: Revert controller wiring and restore build.gradle.kts dependency scope.
